Kaksi kuvaa samasta tilanteesta. Vasemma: Two pictures of the same situation. On the left the situation diagram: a box is pulled along the floor by a rope that rises obliquely, and above the box a thin blue arrow shows the velocity to the right. On the right the free-body diagram: only the box and the forces acting on it as red arrows. The weight G points straight down from the centre, the normal force N from the floor points straight up from the bottom surface and is shorter than the weight, the tension T of the rope starts from the attachment point obliquely up and to the right, and the friction force from the floor points to the left from the bottom surface. The velocity is not drawn in the free-body diagram.
Neljä pientä voimakuviota. Vasemmalla yl: Four small free-body diagrams. Top left: a box rests on a horizontal floor, with the weight G straight down from the centre and an equally long normal force N up from the bottom surface. Top right: a box is at rest on an inclined slope, with the weight G straight down, the normal force N perpendicular to the slope and the friction force up along the slope. Bottom left: a lamp hangs from a cord, with the weight G down and the tension T of the cord up along the cord. Bottom right: a helium balloon is pressed against the ceiling and is at rest. Beside it is the free-body diagram of the balloon as a point: buoyancy up, weight down and, next to it, the normal force N from the ceiling down, away from the ceiling surface. The buoyancy arrow is as long as the weight and normal force arrows together.
Pistemallin voimakuvio samasta laatikost: Point-model free-body diagram of the same box as above: all four forces start from one point. The weight G points down, the normal force N points up and is shorter than the weight, the tension T of the rope points obliquely up and to the right, and the friction force points to the left. In the corner are the coordinate axes: x to the right and y up.
Voima F lähtee pisteestä vinosti ylös oi: The force F starts from a point obliquely up and to the right at an angle alpha to the horizontal. The components drawn with dashed lines: the horizontal F x along the x-axis and the vertical F y along the y-axis. The components and the force form a right triangle whose hypotenuse is F. Labels: F x is F times cosine alpha and F y is F times sine alpha.
Pulkan voimakuvio pistemallina. Paino G: Free-body diagram of the sled as a point model. The weight G points down, the normal force N from the snow points up and is shorter than the weight, the tension T of the rope points obliquely up and to the right at an angle of 35 degrees with its components dashed, and the friction force from the snow points to the left. In the corner are the axes: x to the right, in the direction of motion, and y up.
Opiskelijan piirtämä voimakuvio lattiall: A free-body diagram drawn by a student for a box sliding on the floor. From the centre of the box an arrow G points down, and from the bottom surface an equally long arrow N points up. From the bottom surface the arrow of the friction force points to the left, and from the right side of the box an arrow F points to the right. The arrow F is longer than the arrow of the friction force.
Hissikori ja siinä seisova ihminen sekä: An elevator car with a person standing in it, and the person's free-body diagram as a point: the weight G down and the normal force N from the floor up. The arrow N is longer than the arrow G.
An elevator car with a person standing in it, and the person's free-body diagram as a point: the weight G down and the normal force N from the floor up. The arrows N and G are equally long.

An elevator car with a person standing in it, and the person's free-body diagram as a point: the weight G down, the normal force N from the floor up and longer than G, and beside them a red arrow v pointing up.
An elevator car with a person standing in it, and the person's free-body diagram as a point: the weight G down and the normal force N from the floor up. The arrow N is shorter than the arrow G.
Mallikuvio: laatikko liukuu lattialla ta: Model diagram: a box slides on the floor at constant velocity while it is pushed from the handle obliquely downward. The diagram contains only the box. From the centre the weight G points down. From the bottom surface the normal force N from the floor points up, and it is longer than the weight. The force F of the handle starts from the upper back corner of the box, where the handle is attached, and points obliquely down and forward. From the bottom surface the friction force points backward, as long as the horizontal component of the force F.
Mallikuvio: pulkka liukuu lumella tasais: Model diagram: a sled slides on snow at constant velocity while it is pulled by a rope at an angle of 30 degrees. In the point model the weight G points down, the normal force N from the snow points up and is shorter than the weight, the tension T of the rope points obliquely up and forward, and the friction force from the snow points backward, as long as the horizontal component of the tension, which is drawn with a dashed line.
Mallikuvio: ihminen hississä, joka liikk: Model diagram: a person in an elevator that moves upward and slows down. On the left the elevator car and the person. In the middle the person's free-body diagram as a point: the weight G down and the normal force N from the floor up, shorter than the weight. On the right, separately, thin blue arrows: the velocity v up and the acceleration a down. They are not forces.
Voimakuvio ruudukolla, yksi ruutu vastaa: Free-body diagram on a grid, one square corresponds to 10 newtons. Four forces start from a point: F1 to the right, four squares long, F2 to the left, two and a half squares long, F3 up, three squares long, and F4 down, three squares long.
